lines.text: Joab refuses to let Ahimaaz carry the news, sends a Cushite instead, but then lets Ahimaaz run and he outruns him.
David sits between the two gates while a watchman on the roof sees two men running alone, and David says each brings good news.
Ahimaaz bows before David and says the LORD has delivered the rebels, but when asked about Absalom he says Absalom is dead.

wrong_details.true: he says he saw a great tumult but does not know what it was

lines.text: The Cushite tells David that Absalom is like his enemies, and David goes up to the forest of Ephraim and weeps.

wrong_details.wrong: goes up to the forest of Ephraim
wrong_details.true: went up to the chamber over the gate

lines.text: Joab tells David to go out and comfort his servants, so the king gets up and sits in the gate.
